admission.first_pair_gate: Run one reference and one candidate shard at native concurrency 64 first; review elapsed time, exact coverage, errors/timeouts, tokens and raw answers before deciding on remaining shards.
admission.forecast_only: Prior roughly 3,000 output tokens/s is not a measured rate for this long CoT workload.
admission.state: prepared only; no generated job submitted

comparison.aggregate_rule: Sum item-level correct counts over all eight shards per role, validate exact coverage and zero service errors, then calculate candidate_accuracy / reference_accuracy. Do not average shard ratios.
comparison.local_gate: ratio >= 0.99 on all 12,032 paired items, complete coverage and zero service errors on both deployments; not BTC certification.

phase: generation and answer-quality evaluation; separate from ranked AIPerf

pilot.interpretation: below local threshold on small pilot; full corpus is needed to assess generalization

purpose: Evaluate the full fixed local test set after the 128-question pilot ratio fell below the local 99% gate; not official BTC certification.

candidate.deployment: accepted TP4-prefill and TP8/EP8-decode candidate; protected runtime files are hash-checked unchanged

reference.deployment: stock FP8 SGLang colocated TP8/EP8, one replica per node; no transport patch or backend tuning

sharding.rule: Enumerate nonblank compiled-corpus rows in file order; assign row i to shard i % 8.

title: Paired full-corpus local quality verification
